006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.IDataTypeAdapter;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItemVisitor;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapKey;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import java.util.stream.Stream;
019
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
022
023/**
024 * The interface shared by all atomic items, representing indivisible data
025 * values that serve as the fundamental building blocks for complex data
026 * structures in the Metaschema framework.
027 */
028public interface IAnyAtomicItem extends IAtomicValuedItem {
029  /**
030   * Get the type information for this item.
031   *
032   * @return the type information
033   */
034  @NonNull
035  static IAtomicOrUnionType<?> type() {
036    return IItemType.anyAtomic();
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  @NonNull
041  default IAnyAtomicItem toAtomicItem() {
042    return this;
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Get the "wrapped" value represented by this item.
047   *
048   * @return the value
049   */
050  @Override
051  @NonNull
052  Object getValue();
053
054  /**
055   * Converts this atomic item to a string item representation.
056   *
057   * @return a new {@link IStringItem} containing the string representation of
058   *         this item
059   * @see #asString()
060   */
061  @NonNull
062  default IStringItem asStringItem() {
063    return IStringItem.valueOf(asString());
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Get the item's string value.
068   *
069   * @return the string value value of the item
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  String asString();
073
074  @Override
075  default Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> atomize() {
076    return ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.of(this));
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Get the atomic item value as a map key for use with an {@link IMapItem}.
081   *
082   * @return the map key
083   */
084  @NonNull
085  IMapKey asMapKey();
086
087  /**
088   * Get the item's type adapter.
089   *
090   * @return the type adapter for the item
091   */
092  @NonNull
093  IDataTypeAdapter<?> getJavaTypeAdapter();
094
095  /**
096   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
097   * <p>
098   * This method simply returns the provided item, since it is already the same
099   * type.
100   *
101   * @param item
102   *          the item to cast
103   * @return the provided item
104   */
105  static IAnyAtomicItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
106    return item;
107  }
108
109  /**
110   * Cast the provided {@code item} to be the same type as this item.
111   *
112   * @param item
113   *          the item to cast
114   * @return an atomic item of this type
115   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
116   *           if the provided item type cannot be cast to this item type
117   */
118  @NonNull
119  IAnyAtomicItem castAsType(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item);
120
121  /**
122   * Determine if this and the other value are deeply equal, without relying on
123   * the dynamic context.
124   * <p>
125   * This is used by {@link IMapKey#isSameKey(IMapKey)} to determine key
126   * equivalence.
127   * <p>
128   * Item equality is defined by the
129   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">XPath 3.1
130   * fn:deep-equal</a> specification.
131   *
132   * @param other
133   *          the other value to compare to this value to
134   * @return the {@code true} if the two values are equal, or {@code false}
135   *         otherwise
136   */
137  boolean deepEquals(@Nullable ICollectionValue other);
138
139  @Override
140  default void accept(IItemVisitor visitor) {
141    visitor.visit(this);
142  }
143}
